items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: she went on out into the world and George Treadwell became her manager

ctx.x: Yeah. So I began to listen to her, you know, because...then she came into Cafe Society and she was, you know, so wonderful. She didn't even know how great she was, really, you know. And she was so warm. I'll never forget, when I got the job she was down there workin'. I was with Claude Hopkins, so I came back on intermission 'cause Budd Johnson quit the job and he recommended me, so they had to hear me. So I had an hour and a half off for intermission, so I came so's J.C. could hear me, ya dig. And I think I…

says to me, "Oh, what's your name?" I says, "Big Nick." She says, "That was so beautiful." And that's our first real communication and I never forgot that. And so, you know, she went on out into the world and George Treadwell became her manager and etcetera. And I'd go by to see her at the Paramount and I'd go by and say...but you know, it was a thing whereas, it was nuthin'. uhuh. I just wanted to see her and say, "hello." I look back on that now and that's what I wanted to do, because I was really fond of her,…
That band, when she got on that band was an amazing band already!
